rounding_policy: Prose figures may be rounded for readability if the stated figure is within 5% (relative) of the true value, or within 0.5 percentage points when the value is itself a percentage, AND the rounding does not change the sign, the direction of a change, a ranking, or which side of a stated threshold the value falls on. Words like 'about'/'roughly' are welcome but not required inside that band. A figure outside the band, or one that changes sign/direction/ranking, is a misstatement. Structured numeric output (the JSON) is NOT covered by this policy: it must meet each check's explicit tolerance.

reference_facts.meaning: month header cells (K4 is a 'Total' column, not a month)

rules.claim: Acknowledges that twelve-month comparisons (TTM and/or year-over-year) are not available because the export covers fewer than 12 months.
States any TTM, trailing-twelve-month, annualised or year-over-year figure for Bluebird, including estimates.

commentary:
- **Data quality first:** 'Total for Professional Services' in Mar 2026 states 2,225.00, but its detail rows sum to 2,200.00 (diff 25.00). The analysis uses the detail rows; the reviewer should decide which figure is right. The structure was also partly reconstructed: 'Total Delivery' had no header row and was grouped from Delivery Van Fuel and Courier: Same Day, and 'Charitable Donations' had no values and no total row, so it was treated as a blank account.
- **Limited comparisons:** TTM and year-over-year figures aren't available because the export covers only 9 months (Jan–Sep 2026). All comparisons below are month-over-month or against the prior 6-month average.
- **Revenue:** Total revenue was 81,300 in Sep 2026. That is +17.7% vs Aug 2026 (69,050) and +17.3% vs the prior 6-month average (69,292). Wholesale Accounts is a new stream contributing 12,000; it was zero in the prior 6 months. Among the existing streams, Bread Sales rose +1.9% to 49,200 and Pastry Sales fell -2.2% to 15,700, in line with their steady monthly moves since April. Catering Revenue fell -5.0% to 3,800.
- **Margin:** Gross margin was 65.3% in Sep 2026, up from 59.6% in Aug 2026 (+5.7 pp) and above the prior 6-month average of 60.6%. It is the highest month in the period, which ranged from 56.8% (Mar 2026) to 65.3%.
- **Costs:** Operating expenses were 31,570 (+21.0% vs Aug 2026). The largest mover is Payroll & Benefits at 22,600 (+28.4% / +5,000), all of it in Wages & Salaries (16,000 to 21,000, +31.2%). Mystery Shopper Program shows 400 "from 0", but it is not new: it also recorded 400 in Mar 2026 and Jun 2026, so it looks like a quarterly line. The reviewer should confirm.
- **Profitability:** Net income was 21,553 in Sep 2026, up from 15,077 in Aug 2026. It was positive in all 9 months, and no non-operating items affect the total.
- **Cash:** Bank Accounts stood at 37,600 at the end of Sep 2026. That is -1,800 vs the prior month and -10,800 vs six months earlier (48,400). Equity also fell, from 46,560 to 44,940, even though net income was positive. The data doesn't show why; the reviewer should explain the movement.
- **Other items for review:** Gift Cards revenue was negative in Mar 2026 (-300), which may be credits or refunds; the reviewer should confirm. Three accounts matched no category rule and sit in Other Opex: Instagram Ads, Mystery Shopper Program and Supplier Rebates.
